blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Made Simply, With Love! The NEW 2026 L…
blocks_element.text: Made Simply, With Love! The NEW 2026 Limited Edition Bonne Maman Advent Calendar is here. Inside each of its 24 adorable mini boxes, is a unique flavor of Bonne Maman made with simple ingredients — for a homemade taste that everyone is sure to love.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · This year's Limited Edition Bonne Mama…
blocks_element.text: This year's Limited Edition Bonne Maman Advent Calendar unwraps a brand-new design: a beautifully illustrated gift box overflowing with festive ornaments, ribbon, and holiday surprises. It's joyful, and makes a delightful centerpiece for your countdown to Christmas.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · And once the countdown is over, repurp…
blocks_element.text: And once the countdown is over, repurpose each charming mini box for stocking stuffers, place settings, or tiny treasures, a delightful way to extend the magic!

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Perfect for gifting or treating yourse…
blocks_element.text: Perfect for gifting or treating yourself, the Bonne Maman Advent Calendar spreads joy and celebrates the holidays in a deliciously unforgettable way. Whether near or far, you can even create a new tradition by (virtually) opening each advent day together with a loved one.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Available in limited quantities each h…
blocks_element.text: Available in limited quantities each holiday season, once it's gone, it's gone until next year. Although you'll most likely finish these 24 delicious flavors quickly, make sure to enjoy them before June 2027 for the optimal flavor experience.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Please note: The Advent Calendar is av…
blocks_element.text: Please note: The Advent Calendar is available for immediate shipping and cannot be held until the holiday season. Your order will ship according to our standard Shipping Policy.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · This item is only available for delive…
blocks_element.text: This item is only available for delivery within the United States. Please note that all sales are final. Maximum 3 calendars per order. Advent Calendars are shipped per Bonne Maman shipping policies, they aren't held for future delivery. Any questions? Visit our FAQ.
